tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators
policies: No refunds after 7 days of purchase.
24/7 customer support is available only on the Pro plan.
Basic plan users get email support during business hours.
You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.

Free 7-day trial is available for the Pro plan.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter/X for direct publishing.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. No cancellation fees.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes, AutoStream offers a 7-day free trial on the Pro plan. No credit card required.

faq.question: What video formats are supported?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV input formats.
